options.label: Post as text
options.description:
DRAFT (rephrase this):

Hook: Corporate wellness is a $60B industry built on yoga mats in conference rooms. We're replacing it with something that actually works.

Body: Most corporate wellness programs fail because they treat symptoms, not systems. Here's a meditation app. Here's a fruit basket. Go feel better.

What if instead, your office environment actively responded to how your team actually feels? Light panels that shift based on biometric data. Gamification that makes healthy habits stick — not because HR said so, but because your brain wants to.

That's what we're building with ZenithCred. Born from our work with interactive light systems (IAM), powered by real biofeedback data.

Not another app. An environment that heals.

We're talking to investors now. If you're in corporate wellness, HR tech, or just sick of meditation apps that nobody opens — let's talk.

Key points: problem with current wellness, environment-based solution, born from existing tech (IAM), no specific numbers, CTA for investors/partners
